title: Importer Fixes Build Plan
eyebrow: Build plan · revised 16 October 2026 · code stays closed until you approve

short.lead: This is how the fixes get built: cards that show every word of a note, eight-word titles with nothing cut off, a full-screen note view, and renaming. You denied the last plan because it still cut text; nothing is cut now. All four fixes sit under one new parent issue, "Importer fixes after the first real test" (#25). The note view has its own new issue, "Note view: read a whole imported note on its own screen" (#26). The other three go back into the importer issues they belong to: titles into "Importer: read Keep, text, Markdown and Word exports into notes" (#16), cards into "Importer: the Import screen and the notes list" (#18), and renaming into "Importer: keep notes in a library on this device" (#17). Nothing on this page needs a choice; approve it or say what to change.
short.hint: Tap a step to see what it changes and how it is checked.
items: Short titles (issue #16, reading the exported note files)

In app/js/import-read.js, a long first line of a text file gives a title made of its first eight words, with no "…", and the whole line stays at the start of the note's text, so the card shows it in full. A short first line followed by more text stays the title, as now. Word files get the same rule.

after.alt: The same note card with an eight-word title and the full sentence below it

items: Cards that show the whole note (issue #18, Importer: the Import screen and the notes list)
In app/js/notes-view.js, the note card stops cutting its text at 140 characters. It shows every word of the note and every checklist item with its tick.
Renaming that survives a re-import (issue #17, the notes library, where imported notes are stored)
app/js/notes-library.js gains a rename that marks the title as yours, and a re-import of the same note keeps your title while still updating the text of a note you haven't sorted yet.
The note view (issue #26, Note view: read a whole imported note on its own screen)

Tapping a card opens the whole note on its own screen. It shows an editable title, the full text, every checklist item with its tick, the labels, "archived in Keep" when it was, the source file name and the import date. A Back button returns to the same place in the list. The title box is two lines tall, because an eight-word title doesn't fit on one line of a phone screen.

items: Check it in a real browser (issue #19, Importer: check it in a real browser and write it up)

The importer browser check grows: a one-paragraph note of 60 words gets an eight-word title with no "…", its card and its note view both show every word, a renamed title survives a reload and a re-import, and Back returns to the list. It runs twice, at phone and desktop width, and I look at the screenshots.
